channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Fill in the blank in the quiz: Trump's says his triumphal arch will include _____
item.description: Plus: It's a very special week! But which one?

item.title: Americans are confused and worried about elections. Will that impact turnout?
item.description: New polling shows many voters are concerned about the midterms. But prior elections show no clear link between voter concerns and fewer voters actually casting ballots.

item.title: As election enters its final stretch, some Republicans are distancing from Trump
item.description: With less than six weeks until Election Day, a growing number of Republicans are breaking from Trump on key issues. It comes as the party is scrambling to hold onto a slim majority in Congress.

item.title: Trump's state dinner for Xi features sea bass and a long list of tech titans
item.description: A tech-heavy guest list, the fashion choices of those on it, who sat where and what was on the menu marked the softer — often and glitzier — details of diplomacy as Donald Trump threw a Thursday night state dinner honoring China's leader Xi Jinping.

item.title: Man shot during 2024 Trump campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, has died
item.description: James Copenhaver, one of three campaign rally attendees shot in 2024 during an assassination attempt on then-candidate Donald Trump, has died in Pittsburgh, his lawyer said Thursday. He was 76.

item.title: Mistress told ‘American Idol’ contestant she wanted ‘to kill’ wife but testified divorce, not murder, was plan
item.description: Alleigha Botner testified about Caleb Flynn's eerie remark after Ashley Flynn's death and the final messages exchanged before the shooting.

item.title: Cut the bull: The real reason beef costs so much — and what Trump is trying to do
item.description: Ground beef hit a record $6.92 per pound as the U.S. cattle herd falls to a 75-year low, and Trump signed executive orders targeting beef industry reform.

item.title: Donalds rips opponent’s ‘complete 180’ as Dem’s own 2016 words come back to haunt him in tightening gov race
item.description: Byron Donalds attacks David Jolly's shifting stances on abortion, immigration and drilling, calling them political convenience in Florida's governor race.

item.title: UMass Dartmouth football murder suspect overstayed tourist visa, received deferred action: federal sources
item.description: Chukwunonso Eze entered the U.S. on a tourist visa in 2015 and received deferred action under both Biden and Trump before he allegedly killed a UMass Dartmouth football player.

item.title: Indiana Fever routed by Lynx in regular season finale as Caitlin Clark posts career-worst performance
item.description: Caitlin Clark was held to a career-worst two points on 1-of-12 shooting as the Minnesota Lynx routed the Indiana Fever 86-66 in the finale.

item.title: Mamdani-backed socialist arrested at anti-Netanyahu protest outside UN
item.description: Mamdani-backed socialist House candidate Darializa Avila Chevalier, was arrested at an anti-Netanyahu protest blocking roads near the U.N. General Assembly meeting Thursday.

item.title: Final Sophie Cunningham rally of the 2026 regular season pits supporters against trans activists in Minnesota
item.description: A pro-transgender counterprotester told Sophie Cunningham supporters they "should have been aborted" outside the Indiana Fever's Minnesota Lynx game.

item.title: Xi can’t escape protesters’ cries at deafening dinner demonstration
item.description: Protesters chanting "Free Hong Kong" and demanding freedom for political prisoners were heard over Trump's State Dinner welcoming Xi Jinping.

item.title: Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson criticizes Supreme Court’s use of emergency docket
item.description: In a public appearance, Jackson said the high court’s use of the emergency docket was “problematic” and called for more restraint from her colleagues when using it.

item.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to allow ‘third country’ deportations for now
item.description: A lower court blocked the policy, which has sent thousands of migrants to countries where they are not citizens.

item.title: Tropical Storm Nolo tracker: Map and projected storm path
item.description: Nolo is the 14th named storm of the hurricane season in the central Pacific.

item.title: Officials seek answers after man police say was fleeing ICE dies in car crash
item.description: The man was driving Sunday morning in Grand Rapids, Michigan, when at some point before the crash ICE attempted to stop the vehicle, police said.

item.title: ‘I am the code’: Trump clashed with ballroom architect over safety issues
item.description: James McCrery II resigned in October after warning that the president was insisting on designs that violated fire and safety codes.

item.title: Another U.S. service member dies amid Iran war, Pentagon tally shows
item.description: The Defense Department’s disclosed total stands at 19 fatalities, though U.S. officials say the actual number is higher.

item.title: What does Trump want with the U.N.?
item.description: The president has been critical of the organization, but the prestige it holds provides an opportunity to literally speak on the world stage.
